rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0026, tv_iterations=500, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-18 EFFICIENCY probe at the peak lambda. iter-17 (lambda=2.6e-3, 1000it) hr=0.36293 NEW BEST. Early convergence sweep was done at lambda=1e-3 (iter-1..4); at the higher peak lambda the TV term is weighted ~2.6x stronger so the optimum may arrive in fewer iters. ONE knob: tv_iterations 1000->500 (halve; keep lambda=2.6e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gd, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: if hr stays near 0.36293 at 500 iters the peak-lambda optimum arrives early and the full 950s is unnecessary (cheaper equivalent); if hr drops materially, 1000 iters is genuinely needed for convergence at this lambda. Budget: ~500s at 500 iters, well <1200s wall.
